purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software – daily statistics CSV output for medical treatment dates (診療年月日)
purpose.summary: ORCBD999 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that reads an indexed receipt/payment file (BD00801) and produces a daily statistics CSV file (nikkei_*.csv) containing patient visit counts, insurance points, and payment amounts broken down by insurance category. It initialises from command-line parameters, iterates through records, accumulates summary totals, and writes CSV output with Japanese-language column headers.

notable_features: INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode (ISAM)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments and data literals (latin-1 decoded)
CSV output generation with comma-delimited header literals
REDEFINES on ISAM key for multiple key layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or via shell)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial data
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese); decoded as latin-1 so Japanese text appears as mojibake in the snippet. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 72100 bytes (1806 lines total). The ORCA project is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system maintained by JMA; this is a production-grade component.
